digest.component_or_area: Jira DC capability mapping CI workflow
propositions: An on-demand, manually-dispatched CI workflow boots the amd64-only Jira DC image and interrogates it to capture structured inventory (issue types, workflows, statuses, fields, priorities, link types) and execute configuration experiments (REST create operations, screen mutations, sub-task parent operations), emitting raw request/response evidence keyed by id so answers remain traceable to data rather than model summary

The declared environment contract is committed as data, consumed by the harness setup assertion without re-derivation at test time, and pinned to the image digest by reading the Dockerfile FROM line rather than maintaining a second hardcoded constant that could drift

The workflow is asserted by test to be `workflow_dispatch`-only with read-only permissions and cannot execute on push, PR, or schedule; the mapping job is an authoring tool producing committed artifacts for human review, not a running agent in the test harness path

Every instance vocabulary (types, statuses, priorities, link types) is measured live by fetching from the single source of truth in the codebase and comparing against what the instance actually offers, reporting present/absent/present-but-different verdicts so mismatches surface as actionable findings rather than silent failures

Link type direction is validated end-to-end by creating issues and observing the inward/outward names read back from both ends of each link, catching inversions that a name-only presence check cannot detect

Field length limits (summary, description, comment, label) are measured empirically at limit-1/limit/limit+1 with read-back comparison to detect accept-and-truncate cases; `jira.text.field.character.limit` is read from instance state rather than assumed from hardcoded constant
